members.join.statement: INSERT INTO members (user_id, display_name) VALUES (?1, ?2) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING

members.list.statement: SELECT user_id, display_name, role FROM members WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE user_id = ?1 AND role = 'editor') ORDER BY display_name LIMIT 100

members.promote.guard: Only an editor can make someone a publisher.
members.promote.statement: UPDATE members SET role = 'publisher' WHERE user_id = ?1 AND role = 'reader' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE user_id = ?2 AND role = 'editor')

posts.create.statement: INSERT INTO posts (author_id, title, status, created_at) SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3, ?4 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE user_id = ?1 AND role IN ('publisher', 'editor')) AND ?3 IN ('draft', 'published')

posts.feed.statement: SELECT p.id, p.title, m.display_name AS author FROM posts p JOIN members m ON m.user_id = p.author_id WHERE p.status = 'published' AND (?1 IS NULL OR p.id > ?1) ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 20

posts.mine.statement: SELECT id, title, status FROM posts WHERE author_id = ?1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 50

follows.add.statement: INSERT INTO follows (user_id, author_id) SELECT ?1, user_id FROM members WHERE user_id = ?2 AND role IN ('publisher', 'editor') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

posts.following.statement: SELECT p.id, p.title FROM posts p JOIN follows f ON f.author_id = p.author_id WHERE f.user_id = ?1 AND p.status = 'published' ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 20
